propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https (http://) URLs without validation, risking credential exposure in cleartext transit, unlike the DC ReconcilerConfig which rejects non-https unless allow_insecure is set
Three config consumers swallow ConfigError exceptions, causing validation rejections to degrade silently to env-only config instead of failing loud per rebar's design posture
The write_jira_config path persists URLs without scheme validation, allowing the onboarding wizard to silently write insecure cleartext URLs
JiraConfig requires a __post_init__ method with _validate_https_url() check and an allow_insecure boolean field to match DC validator behavior and reject cleartext by default
resolve_jira_settings must re-raise InsecureUrlError before swallowing other ConfigErrors to enforce loud failure on deliberate non-https rejection while preserving env fallback for parse errors
